Eight Tamil Nadu Students Killed in Kerala Car-Lorry Crash

On Saturday a car collided with a parked lorry on a highway in Thrissur district, Kerala, killing eight occupants. All eight victims were identified as students from Tamil Nadu, seven of whom were engineering students. Police are working to confirm the identities of the deceased. The impact was described as severe, with all victims dying at the scene. No further cause or investigation details were provided in the reports.
